headline: OpenAI accuses ex-employee of leaking product plans to Apple leadership
summary: OpenAI filed a new accusation claiming a former employee who joined Apple took more than 100 files about its unreleased product plans, sent them to a personal account, and later presented them to senior Apple leadership. The allegation surfaced hours before OpenAI and Apple were due in court, delaying the hearing.
